entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The sentient incarnation of the Mirari, driven mad by oil, who was the secret lord of Mirrodin and sought to steal a planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The golem creator of Argentum who made Memnarch his warden and returned after Memnarch's death.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: An elf Memnarch sought to capture for her planeswalker spark; she fell with him into the mana core.

entities.name: Bosh
entities.description: Glissa's close friend who sacrificed himself to save her.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A tortured goblin who helped alter Memnarch's devices and received the spark.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: One of those given the Mirari to guard.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A newly ascended planeswalker whom Karn left Argentum to train.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane created by Karn and renamed by Memnarch.

entities.name: Panopticon
entities.description: Memnarch's base from which he scoured the population for a spark; it lay in ruins after Glissa's confrontation.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: The orb of experience and intelligence Karn gave to Memnarch; recovered after his death.

entities.name: Mycosynth
entities.description: A spore that converted metal to flesh and flesh to metal.

entities.name: Kaldra
entities.description: Legendary artifacts Glissa collected; Memnarch seized control of the Kaldra avatar.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Undead forces whose commander allied with Memnarch.

entities.name: Vanishing
entities.description: The return of kidnapped inhabitants to their homes.

events.summary: Karn leaves Argentum to train Jeska, granting his warden the Mirari orb and stewardship of the plane.
events.quote: The second was stewardship over the plane itself.

events.summary: A spot of glistening oil catches Memnarch's eye and he wipes it away, beginning the Corruption of Memnarch.
events.quote: the Corruption of Memnarch had now begun.

events.summary: Memnarch renames the world Mirrodin, terraforms it and destroys the ur-golems, then begins abducting inhabitants of other planes.
events.quote: His first act was to rename the world Mirrodin , after his previous existence as the Mirari.

events.summary: Memnarch ingests blinkmoth serum, builds a serum tank body, and dreams of becoming a planeswalker.
events.quote: Memnarch dreamed of becoming a planeswalker.

events.summary: Memnarch searches from the Panopticon for a spark and plans to convert the world into a spark-transfer machine.
events.quote: The conversion of the entire world into a planet-sized machine able to transfer the planeswalker's spark from one being into another.

events.summary: Memnarch finds Glissa and becomes obsessed with stealing her spark; she escapes his agents repeatedly.
events.quote: becoming obsessed with capturing her and stealing her spark for himself.

events.summary: Glissa confronts Memnarch with the Kaldra champion; he seizes control of it, Bosh sacrifices himself, and the mana core destabilizes, giving birth to the Green Sun.
events.quote: The only thing that saved her was the sacrifice of her close friend Bosh .

events.summary: Memnarch turns to brute force, trapping Glissa in a temporal bubble for five years and altering his devices to use souls as power.
events.quote: Memnarch trapped her for five years in a temporal bubble.

events.summary: Glissa wakes, rallies survivors and assaults Memnarch's stronghold, throwing herself at him as the spark device activates so both fall into the mana core.
events.quote: together, they both fell into the raw mana core of Mirrodin.

events.summary: The spark transfers to Slobad; upon Memnarch's death Karn returns.
events.quote: Upon Memnarch's death, Karn could finally return to his plane.

events.summary: Karn restores the souls, causing the Vanishing, destroys Memnarch's body and gives the Mirari to Glissa, Slobad and Geth.
events.quote: Karn destroyed Memnarch's body, recovering the Mirari

relations.quote: none were as close to their creator as the Warden of Galdroon
he granted his warden two gifts.

relations.note: He sought her spark; she sought revenge.
relations.quote: she plotted her revenge against the power-mad golem for the death of her family.
The only thing that saved her was the sacrifice of her close friend Bosh .

relations.note: She dragged him into the mana core.
relations.quote: she threw herself at him, and together, they both fell into the raw mana core of Mirrodin.
